summary: This directory manages the core business logic and domain entities for the application, serving as the central authority for data processing, state mutations, and coordination between different functional modules.
responsibilities: Execute core business rules and workflows
Coordinate operations between different application services
relationships: Domain entities represent the data structures acted upon by business logic.
Services coordinate multiple entities to fulfill complex business requirements.
State transitions define the rules governing how entities evolve over time.
designDecisions: Separation of concerns between business rules and data persistence
Encapsulation of entity logic within specialized domain classes
Centralized orchestration of multi-step business processes
